summary: Entity 630 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives entity 630 one period of territorial validity, from 1886 to where the dataset stops, in 2019; M51 divided that period at 1925 and this record holds the part after it. Its last capital in the dataset is Tehran. This record was written by the import from those fields. It begins in 1925 because that is the dissolution Wikidata states for Q63158027, Qajar Iran, and not because the dataset says so.
